purpose: Identify independent protein-family assays with actually tested binding alternatives before independent-target score inspection.
selection_basis: Primary assay endpoint, chemical identity, context recoverability, and structure correspondence; no independent-target docking results used.
inventory_rule: Retain every candidate below, including failed qualifications. Parent workflow must freeze any accepted cohort and computational rules separately.

candidates.protein_family: POL/CBM67-like calcium-dependent carbohydrate recognition; outside galectins

locators: p.560 Recombinant protein expression and purification
primary_source.supplementary_gap: Oxford lists SI, but its downloadable bytes and Table SIII were not recovered; no exact SD or extra numerical values are transcribed.

assay.buffer_caveat: No NaCl is listed in the ITC recipe. Earlier gel filtration used 0.15 M NaCl; residual salt/dialysis exchange is not specified. Do not assert zero ionic strength or transfer 0.15 M into this assay by inference.
assay.presentation: free soluble reducing carbohydrates, no linker or multivalent glycan carrier
assay.blank: each ligand titrated into buffer; dilution heats subtracted
assay.protein_oligomer: disulfide-linked homodimer; two sites per protein monomer
assay.NB_semantics: No binding can be detected with glucose under the reported titration; categorical absence of detectable ITC binding, not a universal zero-affinity assertion or a numerical Kd lower bound.
assay.ten_mM_is: syringe/titrant concentration, not stated terminal concentration in the protein cell

source_tested_inventory.reported_Kd_precision: approximately; main text describes melibiose and galactose as having approximately the same affinity

source_tested_inventory.matched_comparison_role: excluded from size-matched primary pair; separately retain as source-tested larger ligand

orthogonal_evidence.buffer: 20 mM potassium phosphate in D2O, pH 7.5
orthogonal_evidence.scope: corroborative qualitative evidence; do not pool its observations with ITC or treat it as an ITC detection threshold

construct.cloning: mature POL cDNA; pET15b; N-terminal His tag and thrombin site
construct.expression_host: Rosetta E. coli in main methods
construct.tag_cleavage: overnight thrombin digestion; subsequent gel filtration
construct.sequence_provenance: four independently sequenced clones reportedly agreed; their variant sequence was used to model native and recombinant structures
construct.provenance_caveat: RCSB summary lists BL21(DE3) while article methods specify Rosetta. Main text reports three variant positions against GenBank; deposition annotates four differences against UniProt. Preserve the deposited sequence and disclose this discrepancy.

structure_proxy.structure_context: same-study recombinant POL crystallized with melibiose; specificity receptor proxy, not pose truth for glucose/galactose
structure_proxy.assembly: author-defined assembly 1, chains A/B; dimer already present by identity operation
structure_proxy.assembly_caveat: Three biological dimers in asymmetric unit; do not treat six chains as six independent targets. Full reference validation and actual preparation remain for a separate freeze.

sequence_correspondence.mapping: entity label_seq_id 5-356 corresponds to author/UniProt positions 22-373; label_seq_id 1-4 is GSHM, annotated expression tag at author positions 18-21
sequence_correspondence.assay_to_structure_status: same-study recombinant construct correspondence; exact assayed-batch sequence not independently established

apo_comparison.scope: native glycosylated protein; it is not the same recombinant assay protein

structure_proxy.known_site_selection: Choose author-defined assembly 1; lexical first protein author chain, then lexical first attached glycan label_asym_id. Choose the centroid of the nonreducing GLA heavy atoms as known-site center.

selected_known_site.center_definition: arithmetic centroid of 11 nonhydrogen atoms of GLA G:2

heavy_atom_audit.method: Count unique heavy atom names for every observed standard amino acid against standard residue heavy atom counts; no modeled repairs.
heavy_atom_audit.scope: Complete heavy atoms for observed residues; 18 declared N-terminal residues per chain are unmodeled. No claim of a full-length all-atom model.

model_graphs.role: explicit pyranose model state; not a separately measured assay species

model_graphs.role: explicit pyranose model state; not a separately measured assay species

model_graphs.role: explicit pyranose model state; not a separately measured assay species

model_graphs.name: beta-D-glucopyranose

chemistry.matched_relationship: D-galactose and D-glucose differ at C4. Each matched-anomer pyranose pair differs at one stereocentre.
chemistry.reducing_end_caveat: Free reducing sugars interconvert; Figure 4 depicts alpha pyranoses but does not establish anomerically locked assay reagents. Four model states are two chemical species, not four independent tested labels.
chemistry.model_scope: CCD alpha/beta D-pyranose states only; not a claim that other solution forms were excluded experimentally
chemistry.RDKit_validation: four graphs parse; each C6H12O6, 12 heavy atoms, graph charge zero, five defined stereocentres

qualification.eligible_endpoint: exploratory same-context D-galactose versus tested D-glucose ITC contrast, with declared reducing-sugar model scope
qualification.reason_not_frozen: Source inventory and lexical known-site rule are frozen; parent must separately freeze computational preparation, metadata integrity, scoring and aggregation before any execution.
qualification.size_and_charge_baseline: tie: both primary species have identical formula/12-heavy-atom/neutral graph models
limits: One independent protein family and one matched epimer contrast; no precision or reliability certification.
Free-sugar experimental labels belong to solution species; do not assign separate measured labels to alpha/beta models.
ITC noise threshold, replicate counts, exact uncertainties and Table SIII are not recovered.
Exact anomer fractions and assayed-batch sequence are not reported/recovered.
Calcium-dependent recognition needs a declared metal-aware receptor preparation.
A predeclared ring/anomer sensitivity may yield an exploratory computational test; it cannot establish an anomer-specific experimental classifier.

parent_authorized_computational_scope.primary_aggregation: equal-anomer mean; explicitly a model heuristic, not experimentally measured population weighting
parent_authorized_computational_scope.anomer_sensitivity: best and worst anomer per species; exact computational aggregation belongs in separate experiment freeze
parent_authorized_computational_scope.unknown_solution_forms: furanose, open-chain and solution anomer fractions remain unmeasured; no invented populations
parent_authorized_computational_scope.claims: one exploratory natural epimer contrast in one independent family, no calibrated affinity or population generalization

recovered_assay.buffer: 50 mM 3,3-dimethylglutarate, pH 5.2; 250 mM NaCl; 1 mM CaCl2; 1 mM MnCl2
recovered_assay.NB_semantics: no binding detected under these conditions; no numerical Kd censoring

cross_source_controls_excluded.reason: Table 1 footnote b attributes these values to Castro et al. 2005 DOI 10.1039/B509243D
cross_source_controls_excluded.compound11: methyl alpha-D-galactopyranoside NB imported from reference 46, Senear and Teller 1981; not a new matched same-assay result

remaining_requirements: Recover and visually verify the complete original 7, 8 and 14 stereochemical drawings and their synthesis-source correspondence; do not infer a septanose graph from shorthand gluco/manno/galacto.
In particular do not assume 7 and 14 differ only at the anomeric centre: C2 stereochemistry must be checked.
Recover protein reagent provenance, source construct and assay-to-1GIC sequence correspondence.
Recover injection schedule and compound-specific concentrations if available.
qualification.reason: Text establishes real tested alternatives, but exact graph and construct gates remain open. No candidate was promoted from published calculations.

candidates.target: E. coli FimH isolated lectin domain
candidates.semantics: All three are tabulated finite-affinity values. Prose calling galactose virtually no affinity must not turn its 100 mM table entry into NB.
candidates.presentation: free soluble saccharide competition for binding of FimH to immobilized anti-site antibody Fab

recovered_context.construct: residues 1-158 with C-terminal 6-His tag, produced in minimal medium to avoid bound butyl mannoside
recovered_context.competition_protein_concentration: fixed near antibody interaction Kd; no exact number recovered
recovered_context.saccharide_dose_series: 10-fold pilot dilutions, then extended/adapted range; exact per-sugar schedule not given

structure_lead.primary_source_match: same publication; explicit sequence/assay tag mapping not performed in this audit

remaining_requirements: Recover precise competition protein concentration and per-sugar concentration ranges or accept a named assay reconstruction limitation.
Freeze reducing-sugar ring/anomer treatment and perform the assay-to-PDB sequence correspondence.
Keep Table 2 finite values quantitative; no binary NB label or inferred detection bound.

candidates.target: Concanavalin A and Dioclea grandiflora lectin
candidates.source_tested_alternatives: C-allyl glycosides 1/2 bind; monovalent norbornyl 3/4 mixture and bivalent 7 show NB; bivalent 5/6 show target-dependent results.
